caption: The drawing features a symmetrical wreath composed of two brown branches that curve upward and meet at the top, crossing at the base. Each branch has a combination of leaves and two round fruits, with the leaves alternately colored in shades of green, red, and blue. Some leaves are green with yellow and red dots, others are red with green or yellow dots, and a few are blue with white or red patterns. The round fruits at the top of each branch are red with circular yellow and blue patterns. In the center of the wreath, the letters "L.. G." are written in a black, cursive script. The entire composition is framed by a thin gold and brown rectangular border on a light beige background.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
